notes:
What's new in DuckOS 1.0.77

• DuckStore is the phone's store now: the whole Google Play catalogue, built from Aurora Store's code as DuckOS's own app, with no sign-in asked for (it makes its own session). The old DuckStore and Beta Store are gone.
• DuckPay looks like Apple Pay: your card up top, the face (or fingerprint) mark in a dark tile over its edge that turns green the moment the phone knows you, your other cards along the bottom. The face is read on DuckPay's own screen, with Face ID's looking-about animation, and it keeps looking by itself if the first look misses.
• DuckWallet 3.0.6: adding a card goes the Apple Wallet way (Add to DuckWallet sheet, an intro, then Card Details in steps).
• Settings › DuckCloud is laid out like a phone's account page: your avatar and name up top, grouped rows with icons, Sign Out at the end.
• Home screen: apps can be put on any cell, anywhere between the clock and the DuckAI bar (hold one and drag it there). The ring turns in the rows that stay empty.
• Photos: a deleted picture shrinks away and the others slide into its place.
• Clock: alarms laid out like iOS's (big times, labels, repeat days, a sheet to add or edit), the stopwatch's Lap/Stop and Reset/Start buttons, times in 24-hour form when the phone is, and no Pomodoro in the timer.
• Notes: hold a note to rename, duplicate or delete it.
• On the emulator only, DuckOS's own Quick Panel is back for the home's swipe-down; phones keep Android's shade.
